  > 
  > 1. **Fig 4 caption is out of date.** Panel (c) no longer draws c/g²: the lines are the interval-censored (Tobit) fit log m* = a + s·log g from `mstar_tobit` (points = interpolated m* per margin quartile, secondary). New panel (d): the Tobit slope s with bootstrap CI for default Kernel SHAP, paired Kernel and antithetic permutation, per model, strict P_c filled and P_c^ε open, dotted line at −2. Your §5.4 numbers (paired Kernel −1.4…−1.8, antithetic −1.7…−2.1, default −0.8…−1.2, P_c^ε ≈ 0) are exactly what (d) shows (`figures/fig4_budget.csv`, panel `tobit_slope`). Say that the paired Kernel strict fits are 12–29 right-censored instances of 40/60 (columns in the csv). The probit fit on g√m/σ_k that Outline rev 6 says decides M5 has not been delivered (experiment-repo#6), so keep "not confirmed, not refuted".
  > 2. **New appendix figure `figures/figA_background.pdf`** (Outline A2 "background": exact top-3 set under B=20/200/k-means-50 vs B=50, and paired change in single-run P_c; German n=9–20, ACS-Employment n=30; partial delivery). Your `tabA2_h1` is the H1 contrast table, not the Outline's A2; I kept its filename, so label the two as you choose. Facts for the text: P_c^ε of single runs does not change under any background (all paired differences exactly 0); strict P_c changes by at most ≈0.09 (CIs mostly include 0); the exact top-3 set itself is the same as under B=50 for only 0.23–0.89 of instances (B=20: 0.23–0.47; B=200: 0.46–0.89; k-means: 0.50–0.89). Floor b is therefore a statement about the background, at B=50 only until you cite this figure.
  > 3. **Fig 5 caption:** "K=6–10 models per cell" is not true of every cell: ACS-Income MLP bootstrap K=3 (open markers), German MLP hyper-parameter K=3, German LR/GBM hyper-parameter K=9/8; German MLP bootstrap is absent. Floor c is three definitions, not pooled. German MLP floors rest on n=10 instances.
  > 2b. Interval scope (every figure's json has the sentence): CIs resample instances of one trained model, with one seed and B=50; retraining and background variance are not in them.
  > 4. Table 2 has numbers where the RF/GBM entries were "≤13k"; the d note under it stays (descriptive, two default-budget populations).
